name: get_session_clients
description: List connected observers, the exclusive controller and its lease. Session-wide; no process_id.

name: claim_session_control
description: Claim or renew the sole controller lease independently of target generations. Human scope remains authoritative; target actions still require a fresh generation.

generation.description: Legacy optional argument, validated but ignored. Target generations do not identify controller leases.

name: release_session_control
description: Release your controller lease without stopping the shared session.

name: get_session_events
description: Page the bounded session connection/lease journal. A gap requires resync using get_session_clients; target events use query_events.
